run_build_statistics: run the tool to fetch gRPC build statistics from Jenkins and upload results to BigQuery
scrape_for_known_errors: scrape Jenkins console HTML output for known error patterns and return a list of matched errors with counts
process_build: process a Jenkins build by fetching test report JSON and console output to extract pass and failure counts
process_matrix: process a Jenkins matrix build by iterating over matrix runs and collecting duration and test results for each configuration
get_last_processed_buildnumber: query BigQuery to retrieve the last processed build number for a given build name to avoid reprocessing
